Not considered (CDS 2025-26 C7)

Admission is mainly to a campus, not a major (exceptions: Nursing and many College of Arts and Architecture programs). Must list a first-choice and an alternate campus; applicants not admitted to University Park may get summer start (if selected) or the alternate campus, or the 2+2 plan. Nursing at UP due Dec 1; Accelerated Premed-Medical due Oct 13 (tests required); Schreyer Honors separate app Nov 15

No supplemental essays: the Personal Statement and Activities section are optional (the Common App essay counts as the Personal Statement). Recommendations are not required or used except for specific programs. Apply via MyPennState or Common App

H2 need figures came from collegedata.fyi's copy of the official 2025-26 University Park CDS (https://opair.psu.edu/files/2026/09/CDS_2025_2026_UniversityPark_v3.pdf) because that table did not extract cleanly. Applications rose about 20% from 2024-25 and the admit rate fell from 61% to 55%
